title: Predictable randomness via sample (r) — review required
description: The r call sample draws from a non-cryptographic generator. Its output is predictable from past values or seed, so tokens, nonces, and temporary secrets built on it can be guessed. This lexical rule flags the call; the reviewer confirms the value is non-security or switches to a cryptographic source.
remediation: Draw security values from a cryptographic source. Keep the fast generator only for simulations, games, and sampling with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any sample call regardless of purpose; no-arg generator forms are separate rules.
